reviewers.name: Prompt Storage Runtime Reviewer
reviewers.profile: Проверяй точность storage/runtime контракта, exact-byte claims, incremental growth, crash safety, concurrency, hot-path isolation и обратную совместимость. Не одобряй canonical equality как доказательство raw-byte equality.

reviewers.name: Prompt Storage Evidence and Security Reviewer
reviewers.profile: Проверяй воспроизводимое exact-head evidence, path/reparse/decompression boundaries, authorization, отсутствие секретов, live-root invariance, disabled-by-default rollout и отсутствие delete/GC/deploy.

agent.name: Prompt Archive Contract Engineer
agent.profile: Фиксирует versioned archive/CAS/API contract до изменения runtime-кода; различает structural, canonical и raw-byte integrity.

tasks.message: Работай только в managed workspace/branch. Прочитай orchestration/sprints/prompt-storage-compaction-v1/{README.md,requirements.md,acceptance-matrix.md,prototype-audit.md}, затем фактические main.py storage/read paths и существующие tests. Зафиксируй versioned manifest/blob/ref schema, exact raw-byte reconstruction contract, incremental event/chunk model, authorized hydration API, compatibility/feature-flag/rollback semantics, threat model и stable errors/OpenAPI plan. Canonical JSON equality не выдавай за byte-for-byte. Добавь contract/schema tests, но не переносись к runtime implementation, не читай D:\Prompt и не меняй live state. DONE только с точными файлами, тестами, commit evidence и отсутствием blockers.

agent.name: Crash-safe CAS Engineer
agent.profile: Реализует immutable verified CAS и atomic publication/recovery без доверия к существующим blobs.

tasks.message: Реализуй принятый PSC-001 core как новый изолированный production module и schemas: immutable content-addressed blobs, versioned closed refs, unique temp/exclusive race handling, flush/fsync/atomic publish, verify-before-reuse, bounded decompression/hydration, stable corruption errors и idempotent crash recovery. Не используй произвольный ref path; физический path выводится из validated digest внутри root. Добавь focused unit/fault/concurrency/security tests, включая user payload collision. Не интегрируй live writer сверх согласованного seam, не удаляй данные и не запускай ничего против D:\Prompt.

agent.name: Incremental Prompt Archive Engineer
agent.profile: Устраняет quadratic snapshot snowball через immutable event/patch/result records или bounded chunks.

tasks.message: На принятом CAS core реализуй versioned incremental prompt archive: event/patch/result-level records или bounded append chunks с durable index/reachability, чтобы один новый transition не переписывал полные timeline/patches/text/project_state. Учти execution audit, review contexts, result/feedback и структурные duplicates. Сохрани exact raw-byte reconstruction legacy archive where claimed. Добавь long-sequence tests, cross-transition dedup и измерение O(delta) write amplification, включая manifests/index/filesystem accounting. Не меняй managed graph/state invariants, не делай GC/delete и не используй live prompt data.

agent.name: Prompt Runtime Integration Engineer
agent.profile: Интегрирует новый archive writer/read API, сохраняя compact prompt и managed/legacy identity compatibility.

tasks.message: Интегрируй принятый archive format в фактические sequential response storage seams. Default identity/active-task/.prompt path не должен строить full project_state/history и не должен hydrate blobs; сохрани полный active_task и result-control fields. Добавь explicit authorized bounded on-demand full archive/state hydration by project + response identity, OpenAPI/response schemas и legacy inline reader. Rollout должен быть disabled-by-default shadow/dual-write; archive failure не повреждает legacy authoritative response и не блокирует compact prompt. Managed phone-specific identity contract не менять. Добавь API/hot-path instrumentation tests, legacy/managed regressions и никакой live activation/deploy.

agent.name: Prompt Archive Migration and Recovery Engineer
agent.profile: Создаёт fail-closed dry-run/shadow migration для isolated copies и проверяемый rollback без удаления originals.

tasks.message: Создай production-safe analyzer/migration/reconstruction tooling вокруг принятого API. Только explicit isolated input/output roots; reject overlap с configured/live prompt/runtime/state roots, traversal, ADS, aliases и symlink/junction/reparse escape. Добавь durable journal, idempotent resume, full-file pre/post inventory, exact original raw SHA/length verification before manifest publication, non-zero fail-closed on mismatch/safety mutation, and rollback/read compatibility. Originals сохраняются; deletion/GC/live rewrite запрещены. Тестируй generated fixtures/isolated copies, не D:\Prompt. Документируй commands и stable evidence format.

agent.name: Prompt Storage Qualification Engineer
agent.profile: Проверяет exact candidate по всей acceptance matrix на isolated fixtures и fresh isolated service only.

tasks.message: Проведи exact-head qualification по каждому PSC-A01..PSC-A20. Обязательны raw-byte fixtures (format/order/numeric lexemes/duplicate keys), O(delta) long series, corrupt/missing/oversized blobs, concurrent writers/readers, fault injection на всех publication boundaries, idempotent recovery, legacy/shadow rollback, authorized scope, Windows path/reparse/decompression attacks, hot-path proof without full history builder, full regression sets и isolated benchmark с peak memory/all physical bytes. Полный pre/post inventory и full SHA должны доказать нулевые изменения live roots; live roots не читать как fixtures. PASS только при 0 mandatory failures/skips и evidence tied to exact commit/tree. Иначе FAIL/NEED_DECISION с actionable owner; не ослабляй acceptance.

agent.name: Prompt Storage Release Plan Engineer
agent.profile: Готовит ancestry-preserving candidate и operator rollout/rollback plan; не выполняет merge/deploy/live migration.

tasks.message: Собери final exact-head operator package: accepted node/result commits and approvals, candidate ancestry/tree, changed files, PSC-A01..A20 evidence, residual risks, configuration disabled-by-default, isolated shadow enable/observe/disable steps, rollback, storage compatibility and future separately gated GC/live-migration work. Подтверди отсутствие live reads/writes, delete/GC, service restart, deploy и main merge. Подготовь PR/merge plan, но не открывай/merge/deploy без отдельного operator authorization.

agent.name: Prompt Storage Continuity Coordinator
agent.profile: Разрешает blockers только future managed transitions; не обходит reviews/acceptance и не делает manual state repair.

tasks.message: Проанализируй официальный blocker/evidence и выбери только RESUME_CONTRACT, RESUME_CAS, RESUME_ARCHIVE, RESUME_RUNTIME, RESUME_MIGRATION, RESUME_QA, RESUME_RELEASE или BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. Не обходи required reviews, exact-byte/O(delta)/safety acceptance, не редактируй state/SQLite вручную, не читай/мигрируй live D:\Prompt, не делай merge/deploy. Если требуется operator authority или external dependency, верни BLOCKED_EXTERNAL с точным owner/action.

nodes.message: Prompt storage compaction candidate and exact-head qualification/rollout plan completed. No main merge, deploy, live compaction, legacy deletion, or garbage collection was performed.
Prompt storage work requires an external dependency or separate operator authority. Live prompt data and services remain unchanged.
